verdicts.title: Answer her proposals in one pass: staged forgets, Keep all, and a 6 s Undo
verdicts.premise_notes: sleep.ts decide() (around :276) posts immediately; proposals.py:62-67 forget retires and closes in one call; sleep.tsx:319-322,:352-359 one press to POST; core/sleep/__init__.py:125-126 cap 20, expire 14 d. Gate: the body defines stageAll('keep' | 'forget'). A bulk 'forget all' retires up to 20 memories in one press, which deletes user data on a wider scale than today's per-row act and makes it irreversible. 'Keep all' and per-row staged forget with Undo do not loosen anything.

verdicts.title: The microphone's answer is known on arrival, follows the OS switch, says how to undo
verdicts.premise_notes: index.ts:55-58 mic seeded unknown; readiness.ts:148-160 denied = raw detail or 'refused by the webview', default 'not asked yet'; no navigator.permissions read anywhere in src; registry-map records the voice-io deviation at setup/index.ts:53. Grounding risk: no Tauri permission handler exists (grep src-tauri), so a denial can be WebView2's own per-origin remembered refusal, which Windows Settings > Privacy > Microphone does not undo. The remedy as specified names only the OS path, and all cases run on a fake Permissions API.
verdicts.floor_notes: M, effort 5 (floor), impact 7, risk 4 (floor); 6+3 files, ~350 lines; 8 cases.
verdicts.gate_check: none -> none (read-only permission query; nothing stored or sent)
verdicts.ambition_why: Closes a recorded deviation with a designed denial state. A single-capability polish.
verdicts.grounding_why: The code facts hold, but the remedy assumes the OS switch is the cause, while in a WebView2 shell the refusal may be the webview's own.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Every case uses fakes, so a remedy that is wrong in the real shell would still pass.
verdicts.revise: Case 2's micRemedy must not present the OS switch as the only path: the Windows sentence also names re-allowing at Athena's own microphone prompt (WebView2 keeps a per-origin denial that Windows Settings does not undo), with a case asserting both are named.
